metadata.scope: curated excerpt pilot for Han core-text ingestion
metadata.notes: This asset is small on purpose. It is tied to existing Han catalog work IDs and uses excerpt/paraphrase content for pipeline validation, not for full canon publication.

source.title: Han Core Text Pilot (curated excerpts)
source.citation: Curated pilot excerpts and paraphrases aligned to the Han catalog snapshot.
source.access_note: Pilot excerpts only. Use for ingestion and retrieval pipeline validation, not as a full-text mirror.

text_version.title: 般若波罗蜜多心经
text_version.summary: Curated pilot excerpts for the Heart Sutra, intended to anchor emptiness and prajna retrieval patterns.
text_version.sample_note: Excerpt/paraphrase pilot; not a full-text mirror.

segments.title: 观自在照见五蕴
segments.content: 观自在菩萨在深观中照见五蕴皆空，提醒修行者先松开对身心经验的执著，再回到般若智慧本身。
segments.content_gloss: Avalokitesvara sees the five aggregates as empty, and practice begins by loosening attachment to experience.
segments.note: Pilot paraphrase for retrieval and concept indexing.

segments.title: 色空不二
segments.content: 色与空并不对立；若执著于形相，就会把缘起中的流动经验误认成固定实体，因此不应住相。
segments.content_gloss: Form and emptiness are not opposed; clinging to appearances mistakes dependent experience for fixed essence.
segments.note: Core emptiness passage condensed for pilot use.

segments.title: 无怖畏安住
segments.content: 当心不再被相绑住，修行就从恐惧里松脱出来，转而以智慧安住，形成可用于检索的稳定 doctrinal anchor.
segments.content_gloss: When the mind is not bound by appearances, fear softens and wisdom becomes the place of rest.
segments.note: Closing pilot segment for the Heart Sutra.

text_version.title: 金刚般若波罗蜜经
text_version.summary: Curated pilot excerpts for the Diamond Sutra, emphasizing non-attachment, formlessness, and merit without abiding.
text_version.sample_note: Excerpt/paraphrase pilot; not a full-text mirror.

segments.title: 无住行施
segments.content: 修行和布施都不应依附于可见的相；若心里不断抓取结果，善行就会被自我中心重新包裹。
segments.content_gloss: Giving and practice should not cling to appearances; grasping outcomes wraps virtue back into self-centeredness.
segments.note: Pilot paraphrase for the Diamond Sutra.

segments.title: 离四相
segments.content: 若仍执我相、人相、众生相、寿者相，就还在概念里转圈；离相不是否认世界，而是不再把它固化成实体。
segments.content_gloss: Clinging to self, person, beings, and lifespan keeps thought circling within concepts instead of releasing them.
segments.note: High-value doctrinal anchor for retrieval and comparison.

segments.title: 功德不住
segments.content: 行善、持经、传法都应随缘回向，而不住于功德之名；这种不住功德的表达是后续对照检索的关键锚点。
segments.content_gloss: Virtue is directed and shared without abiding in the name of merit; this becomes a key comparison anchor.
segments.note: Closing pilot segment for the Diamond Sutra.

text_version.title: 阿弥陀经
text_version.summary: Curated pilot excerpts for the Amitabha Sutra, emphasizing vow, recitation, and rebirth path structure.
text_version.sample_note: Excerpt/paraphrase pilot; not a full-text mirror.

segments.title: 净土说明
segments.content: 经典先建立一个可观想的清净世界，再引导读者把信、愿、行连成一条稳定路径。
segments.content_gloss: The sutra first presents a purified world, then links faith, vow, and practice into a stable path.
segments.note: Pilot paraphrase for Pure Land retrieval.

segments.title: 称名与忆念
segments.content: 称念佛名不是机械重复，而是把散乱的心重新聚焦到愿力与忆念上，让修持有可追踪的节奏。
segments.content_gloss: Reciting the Buddha-name is not mechanical repetition; it re-centers the mind on vow and recollection.
segments.note: Useful for later retrieval of practice-oriented passages.

segments.title: 往生愿景
segments.content: 修持的目标被明确指向往生与转化，而不是抽象的哲学判断，因此它适合做愿景与实践路径的样本文本。
segments.content_gloss: The goal is explicit rebirth and transformation rather than abstract philosophy, making it ideal as a practice-path pilot text.
segments.note: Closing pilot segment for the Amitabha Sutra.

text_version.title: 妙法莲华经
text_version.summary: Curated pilot excerpts for the Lotus Sutra, emphasizing skillful means, one-vehicle teaching, and bodhisattva encouragement.
text_version.sample_note: Excerpt/paraphrase pilot; not a full-text mirror.

segments.title: 方便开门
segments.content: 佛以方便开示不同门径，目的不是制造分裂，而是让不同根器都能先入门、再回到同一方向。
segments.content_gloss: Skillful means open different doors so varied capacities can enter and later converge on a single direction.
segments.note: Pilot paraphrase for the Lotus Sutra.

segments.title: 归于一乘
segments.content: 声闻、缘觉与菩萨的路径在这里被重新编排为一种可汇流的整体，强调最后都能通向佛知见。
segments.content_gloss: The paths of disciples, solitary buddhas, and bodhisattvas are reorganized as a converging whole toward buddhahood.
segments.note: Important for cross-text doctrinal comparison.

segments.title: 授记与劝发
segments.content: 经文通过授记和譬喻鼓励菩萨持续精进，也让后续检索可以直接落到‘发心—修行—成佛’这一类结构。
segments.content_gloss: Prophecy and parable encourage sustained bodhisattva effort and provide a searchable structure of resolve, practice, and awakening.
segments.note: Closing pilot segment for the Lotus Sutra.

text_version.title: 大智度论
text_version.summary: Curated pilot excerpts for the Mahaprajnaparamita Sastra, anchoring prajna theory, emptiness, and teaching method.
text_version.sample_note: Excerpt/paraphrase pilot; not a full-text mirror.

segments.title: 般若为母
segments.content: 般若被描述为诸佛之母，因为智慧不是附属解释，而是破除执著、开启理解的根本力量。
segments.content_gloss: Prajna is described as the mother of buddhas because wisdom is the root force that opens understanding.
segments.note: Core scholastic anchor for later retrieval.

segments.title: 空与缘起
segments.content: 空并不是虚无，而是不把任何法当成固定实体；因此空义与缘起必须一起读，才能避免落入断常两边。
segments.content_gloss: Emptiness is not nothingness; it prevents any dharma from becoming a fixed essence and must be read together with dependent arising.
segments.note: This segment is a strong match candidate for other prajna texts.

segments.title: 随机设教
segments.content: 论书强调方法要跟随众生根器而变化：先破执，再立行；先解缚，再说明何以可行。
segments.content_gloss: The treatise stresses adapting method to capacity: first break attachment, then establish practice.
segments.note: Closing pilot segment for the Dazhidu Lun.
